recorded_origin.observation: Seller diagram labels 1/4 inch; description states 1/4 inch (6 mm). Neither is a guaranteed delivered minimum; inside radius is absent.
Existing pinned primary guide gives plain Q235B minimum Fy235 MPa for 0<t<=16 mm, conditional on grade conformance.
Original representative calculation evaluates Ri=t and Ri=2t. These are analytical scenarios; no recorded product-specific bend-radius derivation is supplied.
Strength screen selects t6, Ri6 and Goel Eq2 k1.67 with full source-gravity envelope. Its actual product and complete-joint acceptance flags remain false.
The all-angle reusable packet freezes t6, Ri6 and k1.67. Its later six-case reports apply this unchanged method to each own admitted raised-rail field.

resolution: Keep the benchmark and issued exceedances. Treat the numerical deficit as sensitive to unknown product geometry; obtain thickness/radius evidence before choosing a different geometry or criterion.
